title: CLI polish: did path-or-text; check/export default DIR
description: 'git vouch did' accepts a .pub path or key text; reverse prints the plain (non-sk) form per DESIGN.md did:key note. check/export take optional [DIR], defaulting to the synced registry copy once setup exists (ey47.8).
acceptance_criteria: Tests: did with path and with literal text give the same did:key; reverse of an sk key's did:key prints the plain form; check/export with no DIR use the configured copy.
